label: Heavy going
summary: The Iran war kept spreading across the Gulf and Yemen, with strikes on the Houthis in Taiz and a Houthi missile aimed at Aden. Russian missiles started large factory fires in Odesa and Zaporizhzhia, and Gaza's health ministry called malnutrition catastrophic. Kenya confirmed a third Ebola case, a migrant boat sank off Gambia, and Turkey's heaviest rain in 80 years brought deadly floods near Istanbul. Argentine students protested Milei's austerity. There was some progress. Ethiopia installed an interim government in Tigray, Qatar announced a large solar plant for Lebanon, and a Colorado wildlife overpass cut animal collisions by 91%. Researchers reported a renewable supply of cancer-fighting immune cells and a plastic-eating enzyme. The weighted formula gave 39; no editorial adjustment.
